Name: Combat Dummies
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/fMQDQE1.png[/img][size=3]
Combat Dummies is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]DGA[/url] content pack that adds three dummies for testing weapons.
[/size]


[img]https://imgur.com/vcYxLs1.png[/img][size=3]
The dummies can be purchased from Marlon for 500 gold each.
[/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/h6bFlGU.png[/img][size=3]
[b][size=4]Target Dummy[/size][/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/weX3h4V.gif[/img]
This dummy will display the collective damage it receives.

After one second of not receiving any new damage, the counter will reset.


[b][size=4]Max Hit Dummy[/size][/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/QZPk5Dm.gif[/img]
This dummy will display the highest damage it receives.

After one second of not receiving any new damage, the counter will reset.


[b][size=4]Knockback Dummy[/size][/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/HLiQVfL.gif[/img]
This dummy will be pushed back after being hit, based on the knockback of the weapon.

After two seconds of not receiving any new damage, dummy will teleport back to its original position.
[/size]

Source code is [url=https://github.com/Floogen/CombatDummy]available here[/url].
